name: TryHard Holdings Limited Ordinary Shares
summary: TryHard Holdings Limited (THH) is a lifestyle entertainment firm that operates across both the entertainment and hospitality industries. The company's primary offerings include extensive event management services, encompassing the full scope from conceptualizing multi-genre events and functions to designing and staging themed environments. They provide all necessary technical support, such as professional public announcement systems, lighting, and skilled disc and video jockey technicians. Additionally, THH handles event security, graphic and web design, music video production and enhancement, and ticketing logistics. Beyond event execution, TryHard Holdings offers a wide array of consultancy and management services. These range from venue operations and artist production/representation to security planning, food and beverage provision, ticketing solutions, accounting, visual design, VIP package creation, photography, logo development, and marketing strategies. Furthermore, THH diversifies its business by providing sub-leasing options for owners and operators of entertainment venues. It also independently manages a portfolio of restaurants, each offering a variety of cuisines and unique dining experiences. Established in 2013, the company maintains its headquarters in Osaka, Japan.
